character: Jin Kazama — The Bloodline Soul (Western Heart roster/jin)

coordinate_system.pixel_space: x right, y DOWN, origin top-left of the PNG as stored in the GLB
coordinate_system.uv_space: The whole eye-iris texture maps onto each eyeball. Iris disc centered at (64,75), diameter ~54px in 128-space. Any eye option is a drop-in 128x128 replacement.

entries.name: Eyes - original brown (Jin default)
entries.notes: Jin's ORIGINAL brown eye-iris, byte-identical to game/assets/models/jin.glb image 12 (eye-iris). Drop-in swap restores the default exactly. The default is never overwritten — this is the restore point.

entries.name: Eyes - yellow tiger (owner's 'I like' variant)
entries.notes: The owner's universal favorite: realistic golden tiger iris with radial fiber striations, dark limbal ring, round pupil — composited onto Jin's NATIVE eye texture so his own skin/sclera surround is kept (unlike the universal full-frame version). Drop-in 128x128 swap for eye-iris. Option only; Jin's default stays brown.

how_to_swap: 3. To restore the default: re-embed eye-original.png.
source: Owner directive 2026-10-18: eyes must be swappable Tekken/WWE-style. Every variant saved, never overwritten. Yellow tiger is the owner's universal 'I like' variant for EVERY character.
